entities.summary: Charbel Wehbe is a Lebanese politician and diplomat who served as Minister of Foreign Affairs and Emigrants in the Cabinet of Hassan Diab from August 3, 2020, up to his resignation on May 19, 2021. He was appointed after the resignation of Nassif Hitti.
